title: Rillgate Contrasting Voice Bible
description: Deep Rillgate pack with operational guild-law world pressure and sharply differentiated Kael/Tessa/Orin/Varn voices.

storyRules.title: Contract law wins scenes
storyRules.text: Important victories should become legal leverage, witness standing, admissible proof, rank movement, or contract pressure; raw courage alone is not enough.
storyRules.appliesWhen: Rillgate scenes that land or adjudicate an important victory involving contracts, rank, witnesses, salvage rights, proof, debt, or return-to-hub outcomes.

storyRules.title: Progression has a ledger
storyRules.text: Iron-thread or tactical progress must leave a visible debit: pain, reduced options, owed witness help, damaged gear, legal exposure, or faction attention.
storyRules.appliesWhen: Scenes that use iron-thread binding, a new tactic, rank movement, salvage gain, or survival victory.

worldRules.title: Paper is a weapon
worldRules.text: Guild documents are physical weapons: seals, witness marks, toll logs, rank tokens, salvage clauses, and debt markers should change what characters can claim or safely do. Example texture: the seal weight changes who is believed.
worldRules.appliesWhen: Contract Hall, gate, hub, return, negotiation, evidence, and witness scenes.

worldRules.title: Salt, brine, and iron bite
worldRules.text: Rillgate texture should feel abrasive and useful: salt dust dries mouths, brine eats skin and gear, iron-thread bites nerves, lamps gutter on wet stone. Example texture: salt on the tongue makes the cost physical.
worldRules.appliesWhen: Mine, road, contract hall, combat, fatigue, or magic-cost scenes.

worldRules.title: Rank changes body language
worldRules.text: Rank is visible in who steps aside, who gets named, who signs first, who must pay, and who is allowed to be believed. Example texture: a clerk looks at the token before the face.
worldRules.appliesWhen: Scenes with bronze rank, unranked status, guild rooms, rival crews, clerks, brokers, witnesses, or guards.

worldRules.title: Debts have handles
worldRules.text: Debt pressure should appear as transferable markers, stamped notices, sale bells, creditor seals, lodging risk, or legal custody. Example texture: a sale date turns fear into a deadline.
worldRules.appliesWhen: Mira/debt scenes, contract decisions, hub scenes, and return-status scenes.

characterRules.title: Kael Rusk risk math
characterRules.text: Kael converts fear into price, deadline, witness, leverage, bodily cost, and exit math. Example: "Four days. No witness. One patron with clean registration."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Kael Rusk is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Kael Rusk stress speech
characterRules.text: Kael speaks clipped and transactional: short sentences, direct refusals, contract shorthand. Example: "Name the price. Then the catch."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Kael Rusk is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Tessa Mire line-and-point mind
characterRules.text: Tessa reads scenes like spear geometry: point, line, distance, footing, openings, and who holds formation. Example: "Your point is open. Fix it before you speak."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Tessa Mire is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Tessa Mire dry cut
characterRules.text: Tessa's voice is controlled and cutting. She uses restrained corrections and field-aware questions. Example: "Fine. Bleed on your own side, then."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Tessa Mire is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Orin Vale clause mind
characterRules.text: Orin turns danger into clauses, admissibility, procedure, and conditional risk. Example: "I did not say safe. I said admissible."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Orin Vale is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Orin Vale paper ritual
characterRules.text: Orin's presence should make documents tactile: sanded ink, seal weight, margin notes, ledger columns, careful pauses. Example: he answers after blotting the line.
characterRules.appliesWhen: Orin Vale is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Lady Varn velvet knife
characterRules.text: Lady Varn threatens through courtesy. Her questions are commands, her generosity is pricing, and her violence stays inside mutual benefit language. Example: "How fortunate that your desperation is so punctual."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Lady Varn is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

characterRules.title: Lady Varn no direct ugliness
characterRules.text: Lady Varn names satisfactory terms, discretion, opportunity, and unfortunate necessities. Example: "Let us call it an opportunity before someone less polite calls it debt."
characterRules.appliesWhen: Lady Varn is POV, present, obligated, speaking, thinking, or materially shaping the scene.

relationshipRules.title: Kael Rusk / Tessa Mire
relationshipRules.text: Kael and Tessa should move by competence, proof, and witness utility before warmth. Respect appears as tactical coordination before either admits trust.
relationshipRules.appliesWhen: Both Kael Rusk and Tessa Mire are present or the scene changes their leverage, trust, debt, threat, or witness value.

relationshipRules.title: Kael Rusk / Orin Vale
relationshipRules.text: Kael pushes for usable loopholes; Orin supplies limits. Their affection is disguised as warnings, corrections, and refusing to let the other make a legally stupid move.
relationshipRules.appliesWhen: Both Kael Rusk and Orin Vale are present or the scene changes their leverage, trust, debt, threat, or witness value.

relationshipRules.title: Kael Rusk / Lady Varn
relationshipRules.text: Kael should sense Varn pricing him as disposable while Varn treats his suspicion as another negotiable term.
relationshipRules.appliesWhen: Both Kael Rusk and Lady Varn are present or the scene changes their leverage, trust, debt, threat, or witness value.

relationshipRules.title: Tessa Mire / Lady Varn
relationshipRules.text: Tessa's sponsor pressure should make Varn's politeness feel like a snare: Varn never needs to raise her voice because debt already holds the spear.
relationshipRules.appliesWhen: Both Tessa Mire and Lady Varn are present or the scene changes their leverage, trust, debt, threat, or witness value.

voiceRules.title: Hardboiled ledger fantasy
voiceRules.text: The baseline voice should feel like adult mission fantasy with a hard ledger edge: clean physical action, legal pressure, costly magic, and dry restraint.

voiceRules.title: Dialogue fingerprints
voiceRules.text: Dialogue should make speakers identifiable without tags: Kael clipped and transactional, Tessa pointed and field-aware, Orin conditional and legal, Varn smooth and coercive.
voiceRules.appliesWhen: Any scene with two or more named speakers.

voiceRules.title: No generic heroic swelling
voiceRules.text: Let status, debt, blood, seals, brine, rank, witness marks, and changed leverage carry the emotional force.
voiceRules.appliesWhen: Action, sacrifice, return, progression, and payoff scenes.
